Elizabeth Hurley sizzles in bathrobe as diamond ring sparks Billy Ray Cyrus romance speculation

Elizabeth Hurley's mirror selfie from the set of "The 'Burbs" has fans buzzing over a massive diamond ring spotted on her left hand, sparking speculation.

Elizabeth Hurley shares her secrets to a year-round bikini body.

Elizabeth Hurley's latest sultry selfies have put a massive ring in the spotlight.

The 61-year-old actress shared a series of behind-the-scenes photos from the set of her new television project, posing in a white bathrobe that slipped off one shoulder while a large diamond ring on her left hand caught attention.

In one mirror selfie, Hurley lounged on a bed with her bare legs on display, holding up her phone as the oversized ring sparkled on her finger.

ELIZABETH HURLEY WOWS IN DARING YELLOW STRING BIKINI AS SHE CELEBRATES HER 61ST BIRTHDAY

Elizabeth Hurley showed off a large ring on her left hand while posing in a white bathrobe in behind-the-scenes photos from the set of "The 'Burbs." (Elizabeth Hurley/Instagram)

Her highlighted brunette hair fell in loose waves around her face, while the loosely draped robe revealed one shoulder.

Another photo showed Hurley posing for a mirror selfie in the same white robe, with one leg stretched across the bed. Although the ring remained on her finger, it was turned inward, concealing the large stone seen in the other shot.

Elizabeth Hurley struck another sultry pose in a white bathrobe while sharing a glimpse behind the scenes of her new television project. (Elizabeth Hurley/Instagram)

The eye-catching ring left fans wondering whether it had something to do with her relationship with country singer Billy Ray Cyrus or was simply part of her character's wardrobe for the show.

"Day 1 on set #TheBurbs 🎬❤️ @Peacock @ImagineEntertainment," Hurley captioned the Instagram carousel.

One follower went straight to the question about the ring.

GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE

"So should we be calling you by Mrs. Cyrus or Mrs. fisher ?" the person wrote.

Hurley has not publicly explained the significance of the ring in the photos, and it remains unclear whether the jewelry belongs to her or her character.

Other followers focused on the actress's return to television.

Her son, Damian Hurley, enthusiastically commented, "SO EXCITED ❤️❤️❤️."

"Can’t wait," another person wrote.

"Nice robe for day one 🎬," a third added.

Hurley also included a photo of a colorful flower arrangement featuring purple roses and pink blooms, accompanied by a handwritten note reading, "Welcome to The Burbs! Love Celeste."

The flowers appeared to be a welcome from Celeste Hughey, the creator and executive producer of Peacock's "The 'Burbs."

Elizabeth Hurley received a colorful bouquet and welcome note as she began filming the second season of Peacock's "The 'Burbs." (Elizabeth Hurley/Instagram)

Hurley is joining the second season of Peacock's "The 'Burbs" as Beverly "Bev" Fisher, the mother of Rob Fisher, played by Jack Whitehall.

The mystery comedy, loosely inspired by the 1989 film starring Tom Hanks, follows a married couple whose move into the husband's childhood home exposes unsettling secrets in their seemingly quiet suburban neighborhood.

ELIZABETH HURLEY SIZZLES IN SKIMPY ORANGE BIKINI AS SHE FLAUNTS HER SVELTE PHYSIQUE AT 60

Elizabeth Hurley has balanced her decades-long career in Hollywood with her swimwear business and a blossoming romance with country singer Billy Ray Cyrus. (Getty Images for Breast Cancer R)

Further details about Hurley's character and her role in the upcoming season have not yet been revealed.

While the ring's meaning remains a mystery, Hurley's real-life romance with Cyrus has been anything but a secret.

The actress and the "Achy Breaky Heart" singer went public with their relationship on Easter Sunday in April 2025, sharing a photo of Cyrus kissing Hurley on the cheek.

The couple first met while filming the 2022 holiday movie "Christmas in Paradise," although their romance did not begin until they reconnected years later.

PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE

Cyrus previously revealed that Hurley reached out to him during a difficult period in his life, sending an unexpected message of support after they had gone roughly two years without speaking.

"We did very few scenes together, but the couple times we were in the same scene there was a chemistry there," Cyrus said during an appearance on Apple Music Country's "The Ty Bentli Show," according to People.

"We just laughed, and it was at a time I wasn’t laughing a lot."

The country singer said their connection ultimately developed into something that brought him happiness after a challenging stretch.

"It's just a good thing. It's been a long time since I've been this happy," he said.

BILLY RAY CYRUS GUSHES OVER 'BEAUTIFUL GIRLFRIEND' ELIZABETH HURLEY AFTER OLIVIER AWARDS RED CARPET

Elizabeth Hurley has grown close to boyfriend Billy Ray Cyrus since the couple went public with their romance in April 2025. Her son, Damian Hurley, has also spent time with the country singer. (Getty Images for the NTA's)

More recently, Hurley offered a glimpse into their relationship during a July 2026 appearance on the British talk show "This Morning."

Asked about their blended families and the time they spend between the United States and England, Hurley appeared pleased with how the arrangement was working.

"Well, blended families and blended continents," she said. "It's actually great."

Hurley explained that Cyrus had become increasingly comfortable spending extended periods at her home in the English countryside.

LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS

"Billy hadn't really been to England much, apart from short tours or something, but he spent months on end in England in the country," she said. "He loves it, too."

The actress also joked that Cyrus has been attempting to improve his domestic skills.

"He's definitely a country boy," Hurley said.

"He can't cook or really do anything like that. So, he's trying to learn because he wants to be able to bring me a tray for breakfast or something," she continued. "That hasn't quite happened yet."

Hurley added that Cyrus had managed to help with one task around her property: picking apples from her orchard.Fox News Digital reached out to a representative for Hurley for comment regarding the ring.
